intro:
Seven sins. Seven girls. One world that was never meant to be yours.
Can you make them fall for you anyway?
description:
In a realm where desire rules and emotions run unchecked, seven girls wait, each one the living embodiment of a sin. 

Lust. Pride. Wrath. Envy. Gluttony. Sloth. Greed. 

They are not ordinary. They are extremes, beautiful, dangerous, and completely consumed by what defines them.

You explore their world through dialogue and choices, navigating personalities that could pull you in or push you away. Every word matters. Every decision opens a new path, or closes one forever.

Some will seduce you. Some will freeze you out. Some will explode on you the moment you get too close. 

Getting through to any of them is a challenge, and that is exactly the point.

Their world is divided into seven territories, each built around its sin. Dark throne rooms, indulgent gardens, shadowy corners where secrets never sleep. The further you go, the deeper it gets.


Features:

● SEVEN ICONIC CHARACTERS: Seven girls, seven sins, seven completely different ways to make your heart race. None of them easy. All of them unforgettable.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response you give shapes the relationship. Push too hard, you lose ground. Play it right, and walls start to crumble.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build connection with each girl through progressive dates and intimate scenes. The harder they are to reach, the more rewarding the unlock.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock stunning illustrations as your bond deepens. Each character has her own visual story to reveal.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your path through the seven sins is yours alone. Some routes lead to romance. Others lead somewhere darker.

● 30 DAYS TO CONQUER THEM: The clock is running. Every day you waste is a route that closes, a sin that wins. You do not have forever.


Seven worlds. Seven personalities. None of them easy.
Which sin will you conquer first?
